key_insight: The Generalized Mean-Field Ising (GMFI) family combines dense, inhomogeneous interactions with exact ground-state solutions, enabling scalable benchmarks for quantum and classical optimization.
engineering_relevance: GMFI offers exact reference solutions at sizes beyond exact diagonalization, helping engineers diagnose optimizer limitations without losing a known target.
method: Derive exact ground states through hidden low-dimensional structure.
Classify system sizes and ground-state degeneracies using number theory.
Evaluate quantum annealing, QAOA, imaginary-time evolution, and classical optimization methods.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical analysis, D-Wave experiments, and multiple optimizer evaluations, highlighting unexpected system-size-dependent oscillations in the quantum-annealing gap.
watch_item: Performance on this specially structured, exactly solvable family may not generalize to arbitrary Ising optimization problems.
paper_title: Generalized Mean-Field Ising Model as a Benchmark Family with Exact Solutions
